beats.text: OnlyFans paid its creators six point three billion dollars last year. So is everyone on there rich?
Since twenty sixteen, it has paid out thirty billion. Five thousand seventy-six creators have made over a million.
But there are about two and a half million active creators.
Spread the money evenly, and each gets about two and a half thousand dollars a year. Roughly two hundred a month.
And it isn't spread evenly. One analyst estimates the top ten percent take about three quarters of it.
The money is real. It's just very, very concentrated.

sources: OnlyFans, Aug 25 2026 (via Tubefilter): FY2025 (to Nov 30 2025) creator payouts $6.3B; $30B paid since 2016; 5,076 creators earned $1M+ since 2016; ~2.5M active creators per regulatory filings. Average per active creator = own calculation ($6.3B / 2.5M ≈ $2,520/yr). Matthew Ball, 'Breaking Down OnlyFans' Stunning Economics': modeled estimate, top 10% of creators ≈ 73% of revenue (based on 2020 research).
